pinned.objective: R-multiple expectancy E[R] (see uptrend_pullback/tail_objective.py); this window: E[R]=+1.182, win%=24.6%, PF=2.02, top-decile share of gross R = 103%
pinned.why_new_preset: v21 is the only candidate whose edge direction survived out-of-sample under the corrected objective, and it was best on all three samples: train 2024-09..2026-03 (E[R] +1.164 vs v20 +0.650), holdout 2026-03..2026-09 (E[R] +2.622 vs +0.359, n=14 only), independent era 2020-01..2024-09 (E[R] -0.329 vs v20 -0.625). It also has the LOWEST tail dependence (top-decile share 111% vs v20's 191% on train).
pinned.negative_evidence: On the independent era 2020-01..2024-09 this preset's E[R] is NEGATIVE (-0.329, t=-1.03) and v20's is significantly negative (-0.625, t=-2.73 over 681 trades). The family therefore has NO demonstrated positive alpha; the positive numbers after 2024-09 come from that period's bull regime (the strategy behaves as ~1.6x market beta). v21 should be read as 'loses least / least tail-dependent', not as 'more profitable'.
